title: docs: list sandbox endpoints in the API reference
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added a Sandboxes API section to the API reference covering 12 served endpoints and pricing. It documents the `https://gen.pollinations.ai/alpha/e2b` base URL, `account:machines` secret-key permission, account-scoped access, E2B SDK environment variables, and Pollinations-specific rules for prepaid runtime, auto-pause, refused options and errors. Each endpoint links to E2B for request and response fields rather than duplicating them. Shortened the Sandboxes guide around dashboard and CLI setup, credits and runtime, including Node.js 20+ setup and SSH examples. Added a test that checks every served sandbox route has an API-reference entry; sandbox handlers are unchanged.
